source_instruction: i am searching for a wall mounted floating shelf for my living room. it should be 24 inch size and natural color.
query: Ugh, I spent 20 minutes this morning trying to get my cat to stop knocking over my potted succulents on the windowsill, she keeps batting at the leaves like they’re tiny toys and I’ve already had to sweep up potting soil twice this week. I also stopped by the corner bakeshop on my walk over and they were out of my favorite lemon poppyseed muffins, which put me in such a grumpy mood I almost forgot why I came in the first place. Oh right, I’m looking for a 24 inch wall mounted option for the living room, and the most I want to spend is that one.
